description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Industrial Disputes between N. S. Shanthini and Sri Lank Airlines Ltd.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an order under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act appointing an arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute between an individual and Sri Lankan Airlines Limited. While it mentions a Minister (Ravindra Samaraweera), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content is about legal proceedings and dispute resolution under established labor laws.
